2607.16030.title: Rethinking Quantum Continual Learning with Quantum Fisher Information
2607.16030.paper_summary: Quantum continual learning aims to train quantum models on sequential tasks without losing previously learned knowledge. However, variational quantum classifiers (VQCs) are prone to catastrophic forgetting under nonstationary task distributions. We propose quantum elastic weight consolidation (QEWC), a quantum Fisher information (QFI)-informed regularization method for mitigating forgetting. Unlike conventional elastic weight consolidation based on classical Fisher information (CFI), which measures parameter importance through measurement-dependent output statistics, QEWC uses QFI to quantify the intrinsic sensitivity of the parameterized quantum state. This gives an information-geometric view in which important parameters are identified by the local response of the quantum state manifold. We evaluate QEWC on VQCs trained on sequential binary classification tasks, including classical image-classification and quantum phase-classification tasks. Simulations show that sequential training without regularization causes severe forgetting, while both CFI-based EWC and QFI-based QEWC improve retention of previous tasks. Mechanistic analyses further show that the two methods impose different regularization geometries: CFI acts selectively on measurement-sensitive directions, whereas QFI imposes a denser state-geometric constraint over parameter space. Under depolarizing noise, CFI values are strongly suppressed by degraded measurement statistics, while QFI preserves a more stable sensitivity structure of the noisy parameterized quantum state. These results establish QEWC as a physically motivated approach for studying and mitigating forgetting in quantum continual learning through quantum-state geometry.
2607.16030.paper_summary_zh: 量子持續學習旨在對連續任務訓練量子模型，而不會失去先前學到的知識。<lb/>然而，變分量子分類器（VQCs）在非平穩任務分佈下容易遭受災難性遺忘。<lb/>我們提出了量子彈性權重整合（QEWC），這是一種基於量子費舍爾信息（QFI）的正則化方法，用於減輕遺忘。<lb/>與基於經典費舍爾信息（CFI）的傳統彈性權重整合不同，後者通過測量依賴的輸出統計來衡量參數的重要性，QEWC則使用QFI來量化參數化量子態的內在敏感性。<lb/>這提供了一種信息幾何的視角，其中重要參數通過量子態流形的局部響應來識別。<lb/>我們在訓練於連續二元分類任務的VQCs上評估QEWC，包括經典圖像分類和量子相位分類任務。<lb/>模擬顯示，未經正則化的連續訓練會導致嚴重的遺忘，而基於CFI的EWC和基於QFI的QEWC都改善了對先前任務的保留。<lb/>機制分析進一步顯示這兩種方法施加了不同的正則化幾何：CFI在測量敏感方向上選擇性地作用，而QFI則在參數空間上施加了更密集的狀態幾何約束。<lb/>在去極化噪聲下，CFI值受到降級測量統計的強烈抑制，而QFI則保持了噪聲參數化量子態的更穩定的敏感性結構。<lb/>這些結果確立了QEWC作為一種物理上有動機的方法，用於通過量子態幾何研究和減輕量子持續學習中的遺忘。
